constructions.C1 LS top1-bottom1: Concentrate on the strongest and weakest signal; higher conviction, less diversification
constructions.C3 LO top1: Long-only, single most attractive market vs EW
constructions.C4 LO top2: Long-only, two most attractive markets vs EW (v12 long-only)
constructions.C5 LS rank-weighted: Use the whole ranking: weights ∝ centred rank (2,1,0,-1,-2)/3, gross 2
constructions.C6 LS z-weighted: Continuous: weights ∝ cross-sectional z, gross 2 (score weighting was weak in v7 - retested on FCI)
constructions.C7 LS top2-bottom2 inv-vol: Volatility-adjusted sizing: within each leg weight ∝ 1/σ (trailing 36M), each leg gross 1
constructions.C8 LS top2-bottom2 ERC: Risk-balanced across countries: equal risk contribution of the 4 signed positions (trailing 36M covariance), gross 2
constructions.C9 LS top2-bottom2 vol-tgt: Baseline scaled to 10% ex-ante vol (trailing 36M covariance), leverage cap 3x

signals.S4 rolling 36M sd scaling: standardise by RECENT volatility instead of full history
signals.S5 own z-score (expanding mean & sd): country-level normalisation removing each FCI's own drift
signals.S6 absolute change, cross-sectional z: no country-level scaling: absolute index-point changes (mixed units - BFCIEU differs)
signals.S7 FCI level, own z (60M): state rather than change: easy vs tight relative to own history
signals.S8 3M moving average of S0 input: smoothing to cut turnover from noisy month-to-month changes
signals.S9 blend of 3/6/12M lookbacks: ensemble across horizons to reduce parameter dependence
signals.S10 hysteresis (enter rank<=2, exit rank: persistence filter: hold a position until the signal clearly reverses
signals.S11 threshold |z|>=0.5: only take positions where the signal is clearly away from the average
signals.S12 absolute confirmation: long only if own FCI is actually easing (>0), short only if actually tightening (<0)
signals.E1 FCI + EPS (equal weight): portfolio-level test of adding EPS revisions

rules.portfolio choice (Rule P): Among 45 construction x schedule configs on signal S0: highest DISCOVERY net Sharpe at 10 bps, subject to discovery net Sharpe at 20 bps > 0, turnover <= 8x p.a. and no single country contributing > 60% of discovery return. Discrete schedules use the mean across start offsets.
rules.signal choice (Rule S): Replace S0 only if a variant (on the baseline C2 + 6M tranches) beats S0 by >= 0.20 DISCOVERY net Sharpe at 10 bps AND has discovery 6M IC >= S0. Otherwise keep S0.
rules.EPS (Rule E): Add EPS only if FCI+EPS minus FCI-only paired monthly net return in DISCOVERY has block-bootstrap p < 0.10 (one-sided) on the Rule-P construction.
rules.walk-forward: Each January from 2013, pick the config with the best expanding-window net Sharpe (10 bps, >= 36 months of its history), hold it for 12 months; report the stitched return (switching costs between configs ignored - disclosed).
rules.exploratory: Evaluated on DISCOVERY only for promotion purposes. Examined-window numbers shown, labelled CONTAMINATED, and never used for a decision. No promotion in v13 regardless of outcome: independent evaluation requires post-2026-04 data.
rules.reporting: Every config and cost reported in CSV. Examined window = 2017-08..2026-04, NOT a fresh holdout.

amendments.what: replaced a fixed-point iteration that diverged when signed positions had negative covariance (C8 vol 17-26% vs ~6-8% for every other L/S) with the convex Spinu formulation; equal risk contributions now asserted to within 1%
amendments.spec changed?: No - same definition (equal risk contribution, gross 2); bug fix only
